items.title: Perspectives : Netflix/ Marvel Luke Cage Actor Sean Ringgold
items.description: Host, Daren Jaime sits down with actor and philanthropist Sean Ringgold to discuss his role in the Netflix Marvel series Luke Cage along with his advocacy for children living with life-threatening illnesses and disabilities.
